name: Moveworks
summary: Enterprise AI assistant, search, and agent technology acquired by ServiceNow. Practice sources distinguish historical MLE / ML infrastructure reports from SWE variants.

interview_process.summary: Historical MLE / ML infrastructure sources support the core coding, recommendation, LLM routing and behavioral exercises. A deeper review adds explicitly labeled SWE or role-ambiguous coding and retrieval/assistant design supplements; these do not establish additional MLE rounds or the current post-acquisition loop.

stages.name: MLE technical screen
stages.signal: Candidate dictionary filtering and next-letter selection with explicit tie breaks.

stages.name: ML infrastructure onsite
stages.signal: String coding, app recommendations, a shared LLM provider layer, and failed-project discussion. Some coding details are incomplete.

sources.label: Original MLE / ML infrastructure onsite report

stages.name: Role-labeled SWE preparation supplements
stages.signal: Reports include citation parsing/merging, synonym query rewrites, text justification, sentence segmentation, review search and configurable document assistants.

notes.label: Role boundary
notes.detail: General string tasks remain Coding even when reported by an MLE. SWE corroboration is labeled separately and does not establish exact MLE constraints.

notes.label: Historical coverage
notes.detail: The finite company index was reviewed through its readable bodies and useful replies/images. One deleted report and uncatalogued web posts remain possible gaps. Strict MLE evidence remains limited; the expanded collection labels role differences.
